ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent investigation into Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the Trump administration's decision to freeze $259M in Medicaid funds.
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How will the Trump administration's decision to freeze Medicaid funds affect the state?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud and corruption in the Medicaid system. By following the money and examining public records, we may be able to identify key players and patterns of fraud.
